scope: PEER personally completed 504 case reviews. This closing review checks PEER035–051 proposal compatibility against full canonical definitions and explicitly reuses the reviewed cases named below. It does not claim a new blind review of all 504.
semantic_authoring: Compatibility reasons, approved repeats, open-chain membership and conclusions were written by Codex. Assembly code may only join exact authored rows with existing manually authored partitions and evidence, normalize documented aliases, validate hashes, deduplicate and count. It must not infer memberships from wording, costs, outcomes or candidate IDs.
